English: The recent successful military action by reactionary cadres has caused the total overthrow of our nation’s government. Revolutionary guards organized by radicalized noblemen and clerical dissenters seized the major arteries of government in $CAPITAL$, causing most of the remaining legitimate government to flee or resign. The capital remains in a somber mood after the closure of frantic violence in the streets. Citing causes of tradition, legitimacy, the ancestral faith, and the divinely ordained order, they have rolled back political and social privileges dramatically. The parliament has been suspended, and rapidly a number of edicts restoring the old nobility and church to positions have been promulgated. This will be sure to cause domestic unrest, as well as has destabilized our position abroad as local governments attempt to regularize relations with the new regime. It remains to be seen how this will affect the development of our country long term.
Reaction is the order of the day, it seems.

The recent successful seizure of power by the theocratist paramilitary faction in $CAPITAL$ has affected a radical transformation of our state. After the brutal capture of the city, the theocratists forced a mass resignation of most officials, and performed a couple of particularly brutal religious killings of a number of non-compliant social activists and former governmental elites. They have rapidly set up a parallel bureaucracy as an outgrowth of their paramilitary faction’s political secretariat, and have quickly and violently enforced Theocratic control over much of the rest of the country though local gauleiter and collaborating clergy. Ultimately state power now rests in theory within the national theocratist synod, the collection of life-term clerics and internally elected party functionaries that head the political and military direction of the theocratist party.
I’ll see you at worship, then, fonctionnaire…

The recent seizure of $CAPITAL$ by radical bands of 'Free-Yokers' has dramatically transformed the political constitution of our country. In their iconoclastic crusade against all symbols of privilege, aristocracy, and clericalism, they have routed the last government supporters that continued to fight and hung those which they could capture. Proclaiming the rights of the citizen-farmer and the “unfettered national spirit”, they have established a radical directorate committee to direct the “preservation of the national corps”, which has assumed most governmental powers for the time being. The central government in the meantime has passed a number of radical edicts, guaranteeing the privileges of the yeoman farmer as well as the rural laborer and the urban menu peuple, establishing labor regulation boards, grain distribution laws, encouraging anti-competitive and protective economic policies, and abolishing aristocratic privilege. Now it only remains to be seen how we can spread liberty beyond our borders…
Hurrah for the popular will, I say!

The recent capture of our seat of government by the so-called $COUNTRY_ADJ$ Absolutist Army Faction has ushered in an age of new and shockingly different governments. Proclaiming the ‘age of the state’ begun, in the central square of $CAPITAL$, now rechristened ‘State Square’, the reconstruction of society began with the total abolition of identities beyond ‘citizen’, and it is clear that paramount leadership seems to lie in the bureaucratic secretariat or the military-political commissariate. Most state offices have either been awarded by appointment by the party leadership, or have been abolished and reshaped. Much private land has been seized as “wastage” for alternative usage, and a number of “inefficiencies, abuses, and crimes” have been abolished. It seems that in the foreseeable future our country will be under the strict and punctual leadership of a swarm of party functionaries, teachers, shop-floor managers and agricultural overseers.
Why, good chap, I believe that’s quorum!

Recently, a certain group of new political theorists in $COUNTRY$, stimulated, they say, by a reflection upon the perennial disorders of war, industrial recession, famine, inefficiency, have diagnosed the source of society's ills as not one of inequality or political radicalism, but one of 'anarchy'. Growing out of social liberationist speculation, they have arrived at the conclusion that despite the correct impulses of liberationism, the current state cannot correctly support its intentions. Claiming the current state is ill suited to deal with modern material civilization - the various industrial innovations that have reshaped the economic and attendant social order of the day - they propose a radical reorganization of the state along the lines of the most efficient industrial and corporate enterprises. Endorsing all reforms to rid the state of inefficiency, by means centralized planning, a needed expression of state bureaucracy, rationalization of legislation, elimination of autonomy, etc, the 'statist' ideology demands that the state itself be rationalized to save the gains of social libertarianism from the new ills of inefficiency and the vagaries of the market.

Ever since the increased agitation of statist reforms and political organization, a new, more virulent and extreme form of statism has emerged from a circle of intellectuals in $COUNTRY$ out of frustration with the statist impulse to compromise with and even protect Liberationist reforms. Turning their back on statism's roots as a means for the preservation of social Liberationism, they have come to suggest that the state itself is an 'absolute' good, an entity that serves no greater good than itself. They cry that the efficiency and capacity of the state must be enforced and pursued 'absolutely', with total indifference to petty squabbling and selfish demands of its constituents. This, they claim, will ultimately, and exclusively, bring true prosperity to those members of the state, unlike the illusions of other ideologies which bring only selfish gain to certain members of the state. Ultimately the absolutist impulse is a radical reformulation and indeed clarification of the purpose and even very being of the state: the state should be seen as an enterprise that succeeds or fails in the preservation and expansion of its own power, capacity, and efficiency, and nothing else.

The principles of conservatism and reaction have long languished in the doldrums of opposition and desperate compromise. Now, however, we are seeing the revival of the forces of reaction. The 'theocratist' speculators of $COUNTRY$ make radical claims: everywhere, fat and useless bureaucracies deliver grains to idle vagrants and wastrels who have been uprooted from their ancestral homes, great slum tenements have risen up in our once bright cities, the humble farmer is ruined by the slump in the prices of commodities, and mankind wallows, spiritually blighted by this atheistic age of worldly delights. And so a voice hearkens for the halcyon days of yore, when each man knew his station and worked the land of a fatherly lord. A day when each man did not indulge in strange, synthetic compounds, or interpret scriptures in his own degenerate way, but listened to the strictures of the educated priest. But how to achieve this, in such an age of markets and factories? The theocratist ideology claims that the authoritarian and centralizing implements of the modern state pioneered by statism must be employed in fact explicitly for the sake of moral edification and social order.

Conscripts are being drafted left and right and the poor are being trained and prepared to fight. Military camps are full of fresh recruits, troops are carrying out exercises in our borders and every aspect of society and every signal the government gives seems to indicate a war is in progress, yet there's no war. This large disruption in the country's daily life is angering our population and making our neighbours increasingly wary.

Recent reforms in our state have dramatically elevated the significance and constitutional role of a number of religious authorities and bodies. This preponderant influence of the clergy and faith institutions in decision making, legislation, and judgment means our state most properly ought to be described as a 'theocracy' above anything else. Gradually, through the influence of the courts and religious police, much of the nominally “secular” government has become beholden to religious authorities, and has melded into one structure. Religious discourse dominates the public sphere, and there is at this point very few who would not publicly profess the state faith.
Glory be, and all that, yes, yes.

Recent reforms in our country have graduated centralized power around a single authoritarian personage of an aristocratic dynasty, suggesting that at this point it is probably appropriate to call our country a “princely despotate”, as per the common parlance. This creeping shift has occurred as the executive has gradually gained power by the slow removal of special ecclesiastical dominion, as well as centralized the bureaucracy in the hands of loyalist bourgeois officeholders. The effective decline of aristocratic power in active governance has weakened the parliament with the rise of the power of the prince. Local magnates and squires in the countryside are bewailing a decline in “natural liberties” and “the old constitution and our beloved commonwealth”, and clerics are warning of a “new secularism”, but it seems most subjects have quiescently accepted the augmented power of our monarch, who increasingly formalizes their power by the day, as the royal court grows more sure of itself.
Well, at least it will cut down on squabbling...

Our state has recently undergone a number of critical political changes related to political decentralization, corporate legislation, and aristocratic privilege, such that we might at this point call our country an “aristocratic commonwealth”. Power lies now first and foremost amongst a body of great noble proprietors collaborating in a parliamentary body. The gradual devolution of both the regional executive and judicial powers to local aristocratic magnates has enabled the graduate capture of the country by these great barons and marcher lords. While this generally bodes poorly for the serf and whatever remnants of an executive remain, most burghers and yeomen have silently accepted the changes, integrating themselves into the increasingly aristocratic structures through town charters and elective corporations. It is not long, surely, before the executive is neigh more than a figurehead, and the church is all but private property of the local lord, some are saying.
Two, or six hundred, heads, are better than one?

The practice of serfdom - land-labour bondage of all types, has been abolished in all manners in our nation. All banalities, corvee, tributes, and levies have been strictly banned. This is likely to enrage many great aristocrats and their servants, who hate to see this ancient rite disappear. They bewail the end of the bond between lord and villein, an ancient bond going far back into yore. However, these dues have long worn upon our people, and the rural folk resent greatly these impositions on their lives. Many considered these restrictions on movement, land usage, and labor sales a great drag on our economy as well. The so-called 'serf problem', which has created many dilapidated estates and rural slums, will hopefully be gradually cleared up by this effort to suppress these unjust dues, regularize our economy and land usage, and make these families a functioning part of our markets.
Well, that will make these folk jolly!

The barbaric practice of thralldom - the rearing, culling, vending, driving, transhumance, pasturing, breeding, and above all consuming the flesh of hominid cattle, or ‘thralls’ has finally been abolished in our country. This will greatly enrage all traditionalists of various types - great landowners, wretched yeomen, and consumers with a certain taste for man flesh. Nonetheless, its quite clear that this clumsy and strange practise was a great drag on our economy and our moral decency as a state. Now these able bodies folk will surely be free to join the economy, and we will no longer have the stain of near-cannibalism on our consciousness.

$MONARCHTITLE$, the $FROMCOUNTRY_ADJ$ ambassador has presented us with news from the $UNION_ADJ$ Congress. $FROMCOUNTRY$ has accepted the $UNION_ADJ$ crown, and proclaimed themselves the one true $UNION_ADJ$ nation. These winds of change will be hard to resist.
We will not have our ancestral rights infringed!

French: A rising tide of nationalism within greater $CULTURE_GROUP_UNION$ has toppled the government in $FROMCOUNTRY$. A congress of nationalistic revolutionaries has been convened, with representatives from all of $CULTURE_GROUP_UNION$, which has decreed that the time is right for the nation to unite under one banner. The congress has offered the crown of this united $CULTURE_GROUP_UNION$ to us. We could accept the offer, but doing so would cause international alarm, and require us to compensate the revolutionaries politically.

English: I will not accept a crown from the gutter.

It has been about a decade since we stacked the upper house with loyal partisans, and though the memory this scandal still remains among the minds of few, the general public has moved on and seemingly forgotten about it.
The $FROMCOUNTRY_ADJ$ nation has requested a sum of money from any nations willing to fund them.
$FROMCOUNTRY$ Defaults in Defiance of our Military!

I pledge you, I pledge myself to a new deal for the $FROMCOUNTRY_ADJ$ people. Let us here assembled constitute ourselves prophets of a new order of competence and courage. This is more than a political campaign, it is a call to arms...\n\nA spokesperson of the $COUNTRY_ADJ$ government was quoted saying as the matter of the $FROMCOUNTRY_ADJ$ debt exploded in the press. They went bankrupt again, defying previous treaties and now there's talk of military intervention to make sure we will get paid.
We are ready to move from the conference to the battlefield table.
Issue an official declaration forgiving their debt.

Any lack of confidence in the economic future of $FROMCOUNTRY$ is foolish, the $FROMCOUNTRY_ADJ$ ruler was quoted as saying, "I do not believe that the power and the duty of the $FROMCOUNTRY_ADJ$ Government ought to be extended to the relief of individual suffering.... The lesson should be constantly enforced that though the people support the Government, the Government should not support the people."\n\nAs the $FROMCOUNTRY_ADJ$ defaults on their debts, the civil servants and the economy are suffering greatly from austerity measures. They owed us some money when they defaulted but since the amount is small, we wouldn't normally take any action. We can choose to act, but not forgiving such a small debt will get some worried and angry reactions from the Great Powers.
$FROMCOUNTRY$ better pay their debts from now on.
We will have our money back.
Issue an official declaration forgiving their debt.

Wave after wave of selling again moved down prices on the Stock Exchange today and billions of moji were clipped from values. Traders surged about brokerage offices watching their holdings wiped out.... It was one of the worst breaks in history.... For a time, in the morning, the market was showing signs of rallying power.... Then new waves of selling out of poorly margined accounts started another reaction...\n\n$FROMCOUNTRY$ has gone bankrupt and defaulted on all their debts. We must use our military might if we want to safeguard our investors.
Issue an official declaration forgiving their debt.

A half abandoned leviathan stuck in the coast. That is how locals in $PROVINCENAME$ describe the decrepit facilities of the old naval base that used to be a local asset strategically important for the $COUNTRY_ADJ$ government. In truth, the naval base has been in decline for a long while and the government defaulting is just the rock bottom. Hit with a severe economic recession in $YEAR$, $COUNTRY_ADJ$ politicians in $CAPITAL$ have no money to spend on repairing and maintaining non-essential staff and facilities.

What once was one of the arteries of $COUNTRY_ADJ$ industry, the railway in $PROVINCENAME$ fell into such disrepair that it's path is barely visible and its tracks are unusable. Economic recession has hit $STATENAME$ harshly for the last years and without money from $CAPITAL$ being invested, most of the railways in $STATENAME$ are in such a state that they will need to be rebuilt to become train-worthy again.

If one in $YEAR$ were to look at the state of the $COUNTRY_ADJ$ line of defences in $PROVINCENAME$, what they would see is a multitude of abandoned bases and unmanned fortifications occupied only by squatters. A fortification is something tricky to maintain - not only it needs regular assessment of the integrity of walls and gates, but also a constant supply of new armaments, supplies and tools for repair. If one of these ingredients are missing, the structures become useless and the military corps are powerless to stop decay from setting in. After several years of hardship, what is seen in $STATENAME$ is this picture, a consequence of the disastrous bankruptcy that is crushing $COUNTRY$.

Our civilisation is a truly ancient one - for millennia our people have worked on the vast paddies and swamplands that constitute the great Poudwouvas river valley. Thousands of years of careful earthworks, dredging, canal construction, and bank reinforcement have turned our great mangroves and swamplands into carefully cultivated fertile paddies for the harvest of riverseed and Pruub flower. Huge mud and root embankments of dense, drooping mangroves line the cuts and gullies to protect from excessive flooding, and provide channels for the barges and gondolas to gently pass through. The houses of our people lie on elegant stilts, or their mud dwellings rest safely atop vast stones moved centuries ago in forgotten engineering feats. When his majesty the Vopodwou, the celestial emperor, the very lynchpin of the world, looks upon his vast domain in the morning, when the rays of the sun kiss the paddies, he can be sure that his civilisation will be bountiful and enduring for the unending future.
The great Vopudshawrish is truly eternal!

The foreign secretary maintains, out of necessity, congress with the leading figures of industrial and imperial circles: elegant soirees hosted for the $COUNTRY_ADJ$ Settlement Society, lavish dinners with industrialists, and hundreds of subtle conversations in private dwellings. Now, however, we are informed of a most peculiar request. An adventurous sort of man, an ex-lieutenant, a self-styled explorer who’s spent time in the far east among the locals, who came into a private fortune by either smuggling, trading, or inheritance (the matter remains murky), has seemingly drummed up a lot of enthusiasm about leading a small band of reservists, thugs, and other martial men to take over some godforsaken chiefdom or other in the wild beyond, with which he seems to be somehow sordidly personally entangled, due to his travels. Most pertinently, he’s passed a request to the foreign secretary actually asking for ships and means to achieve this, promising to incorporate these lands into our state.
Who is this fool? Get him out of here!
We can provide him with funding
We can provide him funding and guns
We can provide him with the boats, the funding and the guns!

About fourteen months ago, our foreign office and exchequer, for better or for worse, provided a soldier of fortune with means to make himself master of a small undeveloped region beyond our shores. His unkempt soldiers shuffled into their vessels in an unspectacular way, and with little fanfare left our wharfs for distant shores, to scant notice outside of certain circles. Staggeringly, however, we have just received a formal communique from this man who informs us that he and his men have mastered this distant land, and established a small colonial government. He wishes to hand over a government of ‘protectorate’ to the colonial office, in exchange only for a number of handsome concessions on commercial prospects and trading regions, and large parcels of land for himself and his soldiers, as well as a small lifelong stipend from the state. It’s better to have such an ambitious man overseas, anyhow, says the minister of the interior.

It has now been over fourteen months since we last heard from this adventurer. Rumor has it that he and his men were eaten alive by beast-men in Shobgizob, or vanquished in battle in some cursed desert in Bafozh, or simply destroyed by a great ocean storm before they had even stepped foot on foreign lands. Regardless, it is safe to assume that this adventurer and his men are long dead, our money wasted, and our officials made to look foolish for ever trusting this soldier of fortune.
Never again will I trust another fool with an expensive dream!

About fourteen months ago, someone, surely sacked now, in the government made the dubious call to provide a roguish and dashing fellow with the substantial means to master a small overseas region for our own colonial aggrandizement. Now, however, we are receiving reports that while this chap did manage to make himself master of this region, he has been decidedly silent in communicating with our government, and is actually styling himself as a local king after intermarrying with local nobility! Him and his thugs have made themselves the effective elites of the region, and have even had the gall to begin encouraging settlements from our mainland! While he has managed to extend the norms of our government across the region, all in all it is a huge embarrassment for the foreign office to have this little tyrant renege on his promises to hand over governance and to continue to live as a prince on our dime!
This blackguard and his rogue state must be brought to justice!

The colonial frontier is always a flexible thing - indeed, all frontiers and borderlands are. Porous and shifting, these regions admit the passage of settlers, traders, laborers, ranchers, trappers, and the border itself encourages the mercenary trade, the suttler’s trade, and the development of mixed frontier communities. However, sometimes these territories can ignite into great conflagrations of tension. This is what happened recently at one of our colonial borders - it’s not exactly clear what has happened, but it appears some movement of settlers has provoked a raid of a sort that ended in masacre. Local gazetteers are crying out for blood, and settler violence has already flared up in an alarming way. The local colonial governor is actually recommending sendings soldiers to take over and pacify the bordering region to prevent excesses, establish a new secure frontier, and address all regional security concerns.
Their lands will fall under our banner!
This is simply not possible at this moment

Porous and shifting, these regions admit the passage of settlers, traders, laborers, ranchers, trappers, and the border itself encourages the mercenary trade, the suttler’s trade, and the development of mixed frontier communities. However, sometimes these territories can ignite into great conflagrations of tension. Local gazetteers are crying out for blood, and settler violence has already flared up in an alarming way. The local colonial governor is actually recommending sendings soldiers to take over and pacify the bordering region to prevent excesses, establish a new secure frontier, and address all regional security concerns.
This will make a fine addition to the empire
This is simply not possible at this moment

The progressive sophistication of the state, theories of negotiation with the primitive mind, and increasing access to inhospitable regions due to modern technology has created a great amount of tension over the barren Sithit desert. This largely inhospitable empty region is mainly dominated by Sithit wastlanders and their thralls, vewugist mullahs, and strange desert fauna. Nonetheless, the potential security issues with another power controlling it has brought this issue to the forefront of political debate on our frontier. Happily, however, it seems the situation has resolved itself! The Gashdzii marcher lords of the western reaches have staged what is already being called ‘Gibbalobba’s Raid on the Mountain’: a wild band of Gashdzii soldiers of fortune made their way deep into the center of the desert to the great lone mountain, stormed the primitive Sithit fortress city, and declared themselves Lords. However, facing native resistance, they are seeking state reinforcements to guarantee their power…
How convenient. Send an emissary and a detachment of soldiers.

The Dheduhd region to our north has long been the purview of slavers, political exiles, and religious extremists. While nominally within our 'borders', populated by tribesmen and itinerant bedouins, this region has long been pointless to control besides by mild tributary means and soft religious authority. However, recent innovations in population management and transportation technology has led to the encroachments upon desert regions around the world, and our interior ministry is concerned about security issues in this region should it fall into the hands of foreign powers. They advise the establishment of a frontier garrison to enforce an effective occupation of this region.

News reaches us from $FROMCOUNTRY$ that the local ruling elites have thrown our ambassador out of the country, and that their troops are laying siege to our embassy with apparent intent to enforce that decision. This affair is developing into an enormous loss of international face, one which can only be avoided through a formal declaration of war against $FROMCOUNTRY$. Sire, how should we respond?
Call our Allies and let's make this right!
We don't have the resources to waste on this.

The long stretch of coast below the temperate forests of the northern valley has for centuries been borderline impossible to inhabit, let alone govern, by all but the most hardy bedouins and their itinerant councils. Hemmed in by mountains, and a calm, shallow sea, these are some of the driest places on the planet. However, as transportation technology improves, military force advances, and government bureaucracy expands, the management of populations and regions like this becomes more and more feasible. Our predominant influence in the posts on the edge of the desert and dominance of the adjacent sea gives us a decided advantage already in projecting influence. Our interior ministry suggests establishing a number of coastal fortifications and naval outposts in the bays our sailors already frequent, and extending the frontier garrisons into the few oases of the interior.
I like the sound of this, minister.
$FROMCOUNTRY$ denies the divinity of the Pudwou!

We are receiving reports from $FROMCOUNTRY$, really no more than a wretched tributary of our empire, that they have suddenly closed the temples to the Vopudwou and have officially removed it from state doctrine that his imperial majesty is the very God of the world! This is heretical doctrine and a horrendous insult to the honor of the master of life and death and the earth and heavens! More galling, even, is that they have elevated some Pruuntish paganism to their new state cult! This act is a blatant challenge to both his majesty's honor and to the legitimacy of our regime. Truly, nothing, nothing in millenia, has brought so much shame to the people of Pruuntia and done such great disrespect to the empire. The people across the land are crying out for their emperor, and the overwhelming consensus is that these traitors must be terribly punished.
It would be delusional to pretend we still hold sway there.

Thick, slick, flammable, and above all - valuable. Since the discovery of liquid fuels for locomotives and automotive engines, and the technology to break down hydrocarbons has become more understood, the oil slicks, tar pits, and underground deposits around the world have been of increasing interest for both large firms and prospectors. In fact, a number of our provinces have suddenly become new hot spots for this activity! Whether stumbled across by a hapless mining firm trying to break new land in carbon rich soils, or by a local eccentric plumbing the land, one can see the pumps going up and the barrels slowly beginning to trickle back to our metropolitan hubs for refinement and processing.

Gums and natural elastics have always been a useful and curious commodity. However, since the discovery of how to process natural latex and extract it from the rubber tree, there has been a great proliferation of industrial ventures towards the cultivation of this useful substance. A number of provinces in our territory have recently undergone a number of changes in production related to these development: explorers and hired mercenaries have generally invaded and graduated co-opted local populations through violence, coercion, and opportunity, to the erection of large rubber tree plantations, the effective development of which we are now seeing. Huge monoculture forests now sprawl over rolling hills, and the little whitewashed cabins of the overseers hold papers and men direct the latex down the forested paths back to our cities to processed into a thousands forms, as tyres, sealants, clothing, chemical implements, and more.

For a long time we have had paramount influence in a certain primitive nation. Our consuls maintain separate jurisdictions, the legation quarter has its own civilian and military authorities, and our large companies have exclusive monopolies over major commodities and trading districts. Our currency has rapidly taken on the role of a parallel object of exchange, and for all intents and purposes $FROMCOUNTRY$ is a subordinate part of our imperial system. However, with recent changes in the global political arena, there seems to be an annexationist fever amongst rival powers. Swathes of territory are being picked off left and right, and our merchants and missionaries are increasingly worried about $FROMCOUNTRY$ falling into foreign hands. The foreign ministry is currently drafting a proposal to proclaim protectorate over these lands and remove civilian and military authority totally into our hands.
It is time for them to accept their new masters.
At this moment we cannot, but perhaps in the future.

Our country has recently fallen under the tutelage of a great power. Their functionaries, missionaries, and merchants swarm over our land. Very few citizens have gone unexposed to the tendrils of their power, and much of the civilian government has fallen under their influence. Recently, however, things have taken an alarming turn. Their consul has made a number of proposals about placing us under protectorate, and ‘reorganization’ of our army, financial structure, and proposing new judicial districts for our own courts. This would effectively annihilate any remaining scraps of independence we may have. This is a crucial time for our nation and we must be very careful if we are ready to resist this great power to save our homeland from foreign domination.
With great sadness I will lay my crown upon the dirt
The streets of $CAPITAL$ will run red with $FROMCOUNTRY_ADJ$ blood!

The foreign minister reports, to great frustration, and shock that $FROMCOUNTRY$ has expelled our consulate and laid siege to our legation district! It appears they are attempting to resist our generous offer of protectorate and are now attempting to drive all our influence from the country. Local expatriate gazettes are reporting shock and horror, as missionaries are massacred, traders are hung up on gallows, and gentle folk are being stabbed in the streets by fanatical madmen! The situation has become decidedly out of our control, and the military is in a position to step in to put these regrettable upstarts in their place, and establish control of this valuable region with which for so long we have had happy and peaceful interests.
Then we shall force them into submission with musket and ball!
Well... let's not do anything too drastic

Our recent defeat by the armies of Poumnia has left a tragic state of affairs in our country. Their savage soldiers have destroyed and sacked our capital, and they have killed not only most of our ministers, but any of the nationalistic elite in a particularly brutal series of beheadings. Any signs of Shamushi worship have been violently stamped out in their long and horrific punitive occupation, and a new collaborationist, decidedly pro-imperial elite has been installed as the new regent class. This marks an age of increased Poumnian influence in our lands, and one can feel it will be many years before the stirrings of Pruuntish identity can begin to organize themselves again after this shattering event. This war will live in infamy in the annals of Pruuntish history.

This is another age of exploration: new steamships issue forward from our ports that allow our sailors to travel further, faster, and safer. Vast oceans cover the majority of our vast planet, and huge prohibitive storms have historically encouraged traders and explorers to cling to the coasts. Now, however, as ever-more liners cross distant seas, we are making a number of unexpected discoveries. Small islands reported by wrecked merchant men in the distant far east, which have appeared and disappeared from our maps for the past couple hundred years are becoming definitively known. In recent months, a small vessel of ours came across a small unclaimed set of islands, and the captain of which, after a small ceremony exchanging honors and meals with the locals, decided to claim the island in our name! It is up to us if we would like to accept these new lands into our patrimony - a new coaling station or trading outpost is attractive, but we would of course have to staff an administration.
Bah, why would we want a patch of lifeless sand in the sea?

Rumors that the wretched $FROMCOUNTRY_ADJ$ have razed our holy site, the Great Drupe, have just now been proven to be true! Tens of thousands of faithful $COUNTRY_ADJ$ Vewugists line the streets of $CAPITAL$ to mourn this terrible occasion. They cry out in sorrow, confusion, and most of all, in rage! Such acts of villainy cannot be tolerated, they cry out! They demand $FROMCOUNTRY_ADJ$ blood to pay for this barbaric act!
Ten thousand $FROMCOUNTRY_ADJ$ heads on pikes will line the ruins of the holy Drupe!
It is a shame, truly, but what do they want me to do about it?

Reports have just trickled in that $FROMCOUNTRY$ has razed our Holy Drupe, a site of utmost importance in the Vewugi faith. Thousands of years of history and spiritual guidance have gone up in smoke due to this cursed war. Pious Vewugis across the nation cry out in anguish at this heinous loss. Many call for an end to the conflict that caused this, while others call for the heads of all leading officials. Whatever the future may hold for the millions of Vewugis around the world, we can be certain that never again will the light of the Great Vewug shine as brightly as it did even a few days ago.
May the great Vewug guide us through this!

It is no secret that the Yamoujoy and Maumoujoy peoples are one and the same. We speak the same language, worship the same gods, and live in the same manner! Even in our folktales, we are born as one family! When the Soil gave birth to the Sky's children, did not the Yamoujoy and Maumoujoy rise from the mud together? It has only been by the will of petty kings and dividing foreign Vewugis that we have become separate people, but now, $FROMCOUNTRY$ offers the people of $COUNTRY$ to form a union with them to finally unite our divided people. We are really in no position to refuse this offer with their domineering position over us, but their offer is kind and our people cheer loudly in the streets at the idea of a union.
You're no brother of mine, $FROMCOUNTRY_ADJ$ swine!

column15: #$PROVINCENAME$ recognized as an integral part of $COUNTRY$!

English: It has been long since $PROVINCENAME$ was added to our mighty domain. Many of our people now reside here and call $PROVINCENAME$ home. Both domestically and internationally $PROVINCENAME$ is referred to as an integral part of $COUNTRY$, without scrutiny or debate.

The time that many $COUNTRY_ADJ$s have feared would come has now finally come. The Poumnians, who for long have meddled in our affairs, seized our treasures, and yoked our people to their plows, have now officially demanded we become their protectorate. If we refuse, it will surely result in a swift invasion, the deaths of thousands, and the complete destruction of Aaykeum.

Our outrageous warmongering has finally provoked a response from large powers around the world. A combine of international powers have declared a total trade embargo against us. Vessels trading in our ports may be seized or even sank with relative impunity, scaring most traders away from our lands, and our neighbors have closed their borders to us.
Time has passed, and finally the international campaign of sanctions against us has ended. Merchants now trade freely with us, and cargo trains are once again rolling across our borders.
May this dark period be forgotten

With the untimely death of our monarch, and the minority of our heir, a new regent has come to power to guide the little autocrat through their minority. We will see how this affects our country's fate.

Our current monarch is known to be desperately besotted with their spouse. Whether though political adroitness, sexual mystique, or some are even saying, occult influences, it is unquestionable that the royal consort is exercising great influence over our country and is the "power behind the throne".
We must watch this one with caution

A certain courtier has gained a vast amount of control over our monarch's favours and seems to have their ear on matters of state. This 'Royal Favourite' is arousing great resentment, as they seem to be the new paramount leader of our state.
We must watch this one with caution

Our ruling party, which maintains pratical dominance over the state through a system of parasitism and managed elections, has recently undergone an internal party struggle. Their opaque dealings are hard to follow, but it seems a new paramount leader has arisen, monopolising a number of key appointments both inside the party and the formal state bureaucracy.
What will their new agenda be?

Shockingly, our leader has been killed in what seems to the result of a private feud! It might have been a crime of passion, or a revenge killing for some old wrong, but the perpetrators seem to have nothing to do with any of the major rival political factions which were at once suspected.

The ruling party of our state is practically synonymous with the state itself, ruling through a delicate system of party-internal appointments, managed nominations, etc. This means that any internal party change is pratically a change within our state. The previous chairperson of the party exited their role yesterday, and today the general party congress has elected a new leader, who is quickly emerging as the new paramount leader of our society.
What will their new agenda be?

In a shocking turn of events in $CAPITAL$ today, the military marched on the executive centres of power and forced our leaders to resign. There are no signs of them, and who knows what is to become of them. In the meantime, the military has put forward an 'acting' leader, who seems to be, for the time being, in 'charge', but many question if it is really the top brass of the army calling the shots.

It began quietly but now it has become a major problem. Over the previous decades, our society has seen the steady formation of a broad, underground, free-yoker movement. From secret societies in the cities, taking the usual cryptic names that international liberationism does, like ‘Dancers’ and ‘Boar-Merchants’, to clandestine rural meetings on moonlit fields by stolid rustics, there has become established a dangerous network of free-yoker agitators. And now, in recent months, the problem seems to be coming to a head. It’s not clear exactly why it began, but early protests quashed by the gendarme have now broken out into large-scale civilian resistance. Everywhere they drag their feet: the fields go unharvested, the yarn unspun, the stones uncut - everywhere they scorn authority: they assault policemen, they loot manors, they riot in the square and they even raid prisons - and worse still, everywhere they call for change: they are organising region councils, they are calling for the estates to assemble, and they are calling for the old order to be abolished.

Finally, the period of Free-Yoker agitation seems to have ended in our country, and we seem to be passing back into an era of relative political disinterest, and domestic harmony. It’s not clear what exactly has brought this about either - perhaps it has been rising economic tides, new interests overseas, successful concessions, or the successful repression and deportation of the worst troublemakers by our security forces. In any case, our society has weathered this period of unrest and we can expect, hopefully, greater calm and unity in the future.

It seems that the broader free-yoker agitation has become particularly extreme in one of our provinces. A group of fanatical free-yoker agitators seem to have established dominance over the local government, and are even maintaining a local ‘citizen guard’ to keep control of the province. The area is, essentially, in open rebellion and refuses to cooperate with our government. This province is a hair's-breadth away from descending into civil conflict with the state. They are seemingly doing everything to propagate their delusional ideology: organising regional land associations, regional grain doles, breaking up great manorial estates, and even emancipating serfs. This has done nothing but stir up the populace to even greater extremism. We must quickly decide how to deal with these troublemakers in local government.
Hang the ringleaders, but allow the peasantry to keep their gains.
Hang these scum and restore order by any means necessary!

Paknâg is a land that has long been plagued by a tradition of social banditry. Since the disentanglement of the empire and the attendant periods of violence as borders were readjusted, Paknâg’s central position has left it a regular victim to the transit of pillaging armies. The perennial devestion, and the cruelty of the castellan lords who barely kept order in the region usually, allowed for the development of a tradition of social bandits living on the margins of society. These freebooters and warriors in previous times often lent their weapons to the defense of farming communities or worked as mercenaries abroad, but now, as the confederal Paknâg state is better able to keep order, they have merely become a menace to the east-west trade out of the south. There has been, sadly, a recent flare up on banditry in Paknâg.

One of the fiercest demands of the Free-Yoker movement goes back to their anti-magisterial beginnings. The end of clerical courts, law, the right to heterodox beliefs, and local congregationalism. With the background of the ongoing free-yoker agitation, this has made the usual seasonal provincial religious ceremonies a point of extreme tension. In one province in particular, a number of free yokers, uncollaborative clergy, and radical preachers have demanded that local communities be allowed to engage in divergent rites from the usual practice. The local governmental officials are refusing to allow this to happen on the grounds that it violates statutes that prescribe correct observances, but a number of our advisors suggest we must tread carefully here and consider concessions.
Grant some requests, but forbid the most extreme.
We cannot allow any sectarian lunacy in $COUNTRY$!

Despite the chaos afflicting our country in the form of free-yoker agitation, it seems that one in one province there has been easing of tensions. It seems the local government has made an effort to drum up fear around the chaos in other provinces, and it seems people have come to believe there are roving bands of irreligious bigots who are frothing at the mouth, eager to pillage their fields. Particularly, the government has deemed it wise to attempt to support a few further proposals to try to divert social unrest to other fears and concerns. Local reactionaries are attempting to organise a provincial militia to defend against the chaos in other provinces, and the government has attempted to organise efforts towards relief in the fluctuating grain market, to quash rural discontent.
Encourage the militia's efforts - that will keep them busy!
Encourage the relief efforts - we must avert violence.
Shock and Horror in the Provinces!

Recently, as a consequence of the free yoker agitation afflicting our land, tensions have boiled over in an extreme way in the provinces. It’s not exactly clear how things developed, but an encounter between soldiers of the state, a number of reactionary elites and their servants, and armed townsfolk developed into a bloodbath. The melee, more than a battle, seems to have involved a brutal and chaotic fight that left a number of soldiers, prominent landowners, and several villagers dead. Both sides, it seems, both claim victory and claim to be the victims of a heinous massacre that left them routed. The whole province then seems to have exploded into low grade violence: several manors were pillaged, a village or two was set upon by brutal soldiers, and the governors has fled to the capital. As the situation stands now, the province is on a knife’s edge.
The Treaty Port of Niiz Moji

Niiz Moji, or ‘Gold Port’ is the oldest continuously established Gashdzii possession on the great mainland of Kovazh. Acquired in 1089 by a concession of Qooxib Emperor Ohadh-Bohen Qamo III, a perpetual charter to trade free of duties was granted to the Jiishanagi South Seas Trading League. The Merchants had long kept an informal residence in cities on the great delta, but now they began building a fortress to protect against the violence of Poumnian rival trader-governors, who often employed the imperial garrisons of Mra-Ouswun in the interest of private profit. However, Niiz Moji’s proximity to the Imperial capital and its place on the river allows for supreme access to the trade of Qooxib and its interior, allowing it to eclipse the older Poumnian traders. Nowadays, Niiz Moji is a byword for lucrative profit, and has grown into a teeming metropolis boasting of over 200,000 residents, with elegant gardens on the river deltas, proud walls, and sober townhouses.
I just love to watch the sun set here, dear chap.

Mra-Ouswun, or ‘Fort Mra’ is the oldest Ishahfazhi possession on the Kovan mainland. It meaningly consists of the trading factory and settlement of Mra, begun in 1045 on the orders of the Viceroy-General Ashou Sha-Shoummid, an adventurous scion of House Shoummid, who was that time the ‘Viceroy of the Pudwou in the Southern Continent’. A fine title for a man who was not much more than a merchant in the Qooxibi capital, but he nominally held the power to dispense justice to Poumnian subjects in all of Mainlanz Kovazh. Employing private levies to aid against a Souxappi revolt, he impressed and gained the favour of Odadh-Bohen Qamo II, who granted him extraterritoriality and allowed him to build a fort, as a nominal ‘vassal’ of the Qooxib. This factory station gradually became a great trading town, was granted independence of the Qooxib, and is still a fief of House Shoummid.

Old Niiz Jadhov, ‘Kingsport’, is a commanding Vokonazhi factory in the land of the Ourrhond, the great monarchy of central Kovash. This aristocratic confederacy, fraught by regular internal conflict, nonetheless yields great trade goods, with carved furniture made from the lumber of the rich woodlands that dot the plains, ivories from the great beasts of Kovazh, and precious objects made by the locals. Niiz Jadhov was established in 1167 by a number of intrepid Vokonazhi traders who took advantage of a civil conflict between local tribesmen in the local region and its lord, Hana Birhim. Delicately balancing various loyalties between the distracted locals, the fort was satisfactorily risen, and became a great holdfast for Vokonazhi trading in the area. Eventually a smaller inland fort was raised, which attracted the local manufacturing community. Niiz Jadhov boasts of the headquarters of the Imperial Kovan Trading Company, nominally granted by the Emperor in Pashdzii.

Niiz Kan is the premier Gashdzii trading port in the west of Kovazh. Established by Ishnapt Tea Company charter in 1160, its key figure is intrepid Bida Kazak, a trader originally based in the island of Rouxaem. Kazak settled a fertile stretch of coast with a hope to plant his own tea crops - he married a local Chobaji heiress and added to his fortune a number of large estates nearby. Shockingly, he and his wife both were buried after the fashion of the Vewugist. A community began to grow around this settlement, attracting goods brought down the coastal road. Until 1221, however, the main Gashdzii trading settlement in the area, Anzhapt, was on the southern delta, but in 1221 the new Emperor declared the expulsion of all foreigners from the delta, and riotous violence drove many Gashdzii north, eventually to hybrid Niiz Kan. The city survived the failure of the Ishapt Tea Company in 1241, and was given a responsible government by the Parliament in Nozho.

Our recent acquisition of a city once owned by overseas powers with exclusive trade charters has caused a regrettable, but not unexpected decline in the trading power of that city. Our proximity to this land, and the revocation of exclusivity charters has effectively removed whatever value was generated by these special privileges. The region has now shifted its production and exports to only local goods.
Well, it was to be expected...

Since we have acquired a certain treaty port on foreign shores, it has now become a booming trading metropolis! It houses vast amounts of merchants, longshoremen, keelmen, factors, agents, secretaries, and other attendants of the shipping trade who work to pull value and goods out of the continental interior. Its proud warehouses owned companies around the world gleam bright in the sun, its great docks boast of ships from all around the world, and, above all, it generates lucrative revenue.

The lands of east Kofazh are dominated by the two great Momurist empires: Imperial Qooxib and aristocratic Ourrhond. These two lands are some of the most populous states in the world, and the great rivers they lie upon, most primarily the Caigur in Ourrhond and Vetchk in Qooxib, are home to huge markets of diverse goods. While not yielding the prime silks and teas of the monsoon ridden west, the torrid lands of the east yield strange fruits, fine pelts, mountains of spindleweed, well-spun cloths, sturdy and elegant furniture and pottery, and many ornate luxuries. These lovely goods are much coveted by the people of Ishahfazh, and our ports in the south east are great trading hubs for this wonderfully profitably carrying trade. Recently, in fact, it seems this trade is booming!
The Good Old Ishnapt Tea Trade

The Great Ishnapt Ocean, the largest on our planet, brings temperate rainstorms to the coasts of the southern continent, Kovazh. Drenched in warm mist, the rolling plains grow the finest tea known to the world. For centuries Ishahfazi merchants have been crossing the Zhibom, the calm shallow sea ringed by the great continents, to the lands of the Chobajhi and the Ftemioq for tea. Our outposts on the western coasts, recently, have been thriving: the tea trade seems to be booming, and our agents and factors can’t find enough tea in the mainland to meet the consumer demand for this fine tea at home and abroad!
The song goes: Sirrah, we brough' ten tonnes of tea to Nozho from Nhanavu...

Amidst the political chaos afflicting our country, we have enough trouble keeping the rowdy masses in line, without the recent developments in the public sphere. A number of dissident and radical intellectuals seemed to have embraced free yoker agitation, and have publicly called, whether in national newspapers, seditious pamphlets, or learned tomes, for the reform of the state and society. These ideas seem to be leaking into the broader public consciousness whether through bastardized doggerel and pulp literature playing with the concerns of the intellectuals, or chatter between the literati, intermediaries, and the masses in public settings. This seems to have inflamed desire for political reform in our society, and everywhere revolutionaries and yokers can seemingly produce the hazy rudiments of political theory and its language.
Curtial these publications and arrest these godforsaken authors.
What harm can mere words do...?

For centuries, the land of Mojifa, the ‘Gold Country’, has mined gold for its daily bread. The great mine of Dhâfkmahk ‘Mahk’s Kettle’ (it is believed ‘Mahk’ was a indigenous pagan word for the devil from long ago) yielded for nearly six centuries a steady flow of gold. It was this gold that garnished the royal jewels of the emperor in Pashdzii, the thrones of the great castellans of Vokonazh, and gave the goldsmiths of Mojifa a superb reputation. Indeed, the coins minted in the Dhâfkmahk area gave their name to the Gashdzii language’s standard word for coin through their prolific usage: Dhâmahk. But in recent years, things have looked grim. The small lodes have grown smaller, and new shafts opened up seem to be dry of gold. Indeed, there has been a recent saying in the area: ‘the kettle no longer sings’. And now the worst has happened: House Dhâfk has closed their shops, told all the workers to seek other work, and are seeking a buyer for this empty land.
O, Buzzamnan, Divine Lady of Fortune, thou turnst thy wheel blindly!
A Scheme to End Foreign Impositions

Throughout our history our great wealth has attracted many foreigners to trade in our lands, and throughout history we have been convinced or, recently, been forced to give the most powerful among them concessions to build fortresses, control ports, and dispense justice in their districts within our patrimony. This has for centuries never been much of a concern to our elite: we grant our diverse subjects many privileges, and concessions to foreign merchants has just been an accommodation to what was, in the eyes of our state, another sort of subject. However, in recent years our people have rankled at the imposition of these trading posts. As we learn more about the global economy and the states of the foreign powers, it now seems a humiliation to have granted concessions. A number of patriotic radicals have thus come to our government with a proposal: provide them with arms and smuggle them into a treaty port, and they will incite a riot and take it over for us!
Excellent, equip them with what they need!
Are you joking? And risk futher imperialist action?

In our concession territory in the $FROMCOUNTRY$ it seems the unbelievable has happened. What began as seemingly a protest against the treatment of local coolies, developed into a firefight at the state house, and, after some street fighting, rioting, and violence for several hours it seems a collection of agents from $FROMCOUNTRY$ have conspired to control the town and in fact are proclaiming themselves representatives of the $FROMCOUNTRY_ADJ$ government! Our informers and spies in $FROMCOUNTRY$ say that this is indeed very likely the case. The foreign office is livid - we are, they say, basically at war with $FROMCOUNTRY$ and must employ military force to recover our concession, as well as teach them a lesson for their audacity!
This sounds very expensive to deal with...

There has been much consternation in the foreign office recently. Our spies in $FROMCOUNTRY$ have whispered the outline of a plot offered to the $FROMCOUNTRY_ADJ$ government to sneak into one of our treaty concessions and take it over in the name of the state! While we feel reasonably sure that the $FROMCOUNTRY_ADJ$ government declined, this speaks to a much more hostile attitude than is usually felt from the large settled empires of Kovazh. There is talk that the usual policy of ‘informal empire’ in Kovazh must be set aside and we must be willing to wage territorial war in these lands to establish military rule and tightly controlled protectorates. These murmurs seemed to have leaked to our rivals in Ishahfazh, and now there seems to be a building scramble to seize land in Kovazh lest it resist or some other Imperial power gets their hands on it!
By Jingo, we've got devils on all sides of us!

§RNOTE: This enables demand concession CBs against the large, settled empires of Kovazh, the Qooxib Empire, Ourrhond, the Pusenetos of the Great Khan, the Nhuiqourran Empire, and the Fazhri Chrur, for ALL civilized countries that have the techs Nationalism and Particularism, Machine Guns, and Medicine.§! Since our scheme to take over a concession treaty port, things seemed to have taken an alarming turn. Rather than acquiesce to our annexation, the foreigners have declared that they will preserve this leased land as an integral part of their empire, which seems to be far different to the treaty we originally agreed upon. Furthermore, we hear alarming rumors that military and industrial circles across Ishahfazh, observing the conflict, feel that there is both an increasing capacity to wage territorial war in Kovazh, and also a protective need to establish direct control over the continent, rather than the previous policy of indirect rule and spheres of influence. We seem to be entering an existential struggle for the integrity of our state.
The armies of the foreigners will crash upon our shores like waves upon rocks.

§RNOTE: This enables demand concession CBs against the large, settled empires of Kovazh, the Qooxib Empire, Ourrhond, the Pusenetos of the Great Khan, the Nhuiqourran Empire, and the Fazhri Chrur, for ALL civilized countries that have the techs Nationalism and Particularism, Machine Guns, and Medicine.§! As our state and society has advanced technologically, one hears increasing talk in military-industrial circles of establishing direct control over the large empires of the Kovan mainland. Typically our war office has avoided even discussing the idea of direct attacks on these powers, citing logistical issues of supplying a large scale land campaign against a powerful overseas foe, but we have now seemingly eclipsed these powers in military capacity. Societies like the $COUNTRY_ADJ$ Kovan Colonisation League, which have recently held a number of symposiums on topics like ‘Spindleweed Growth Opportunities on the Vetchk River’ and have invited a number of lieutenants and other officials to patronise their societies seem to exerting an influence on the thinking of our military establishment.

§RNOTE: This enables demand concession CBs against the large, settled empires of Kovazh, the Qooxib Empire, Ourrhond, the Pusenetos of the Great Khan, the Nhuiqourran Empire, and the Fazhri Chrur, for ALL civilized countries that have the techs Nationalism and Particularism,Machine Guns, and Medicine.§! A couple months ago we decided to cede a leased port back to the Kovan empire that we had it from after an underhanded subterfuge that saw us lose it. Now, however, a few of those merchants we had living there, and indeed much of the former $COUNTRY_ADJ$ expatriate community in the port have communicated to us both the regular tyranny they suffer under this despotic primitive government: floggings, imprisonment, ghastly tortures, and worse, but also of the weakness and poverty of  $FROMCOUNTRY$. Many are saying we have got to wage a proper land military campaign against these barbarians, which has plunged much of Ishahfazh into an annexationist fervor, upon hearing these reports and our rumoured intentions.
Good heavens, we've got to do something! Get the war minister!

Very recently we shuffled a number of agents into a previous treaty concession of ours, as part of a bid to recover control of the territory. Shockingly, things seemingly have gone off without a hitch. They staged a riot over the treatment of locals, and managed to drive the foreigners out of the state house. A few days ago they proclaimed themselves representatives of our government, and now we’ve established regular control over these territories again. The community of $FROMCOUNTRY_ADJ$ waits with bated breath about our governance, but many locals seem glad to be returned to our patrimony. ‘Tis a great day for $COUNTRY$.

The ‘Drupe’ or the Drupe of the Vewug is a gargantuan, rambling temple and palace complex located in Sesi, in the Sublime Veyethu. It is the focal point of the Vewugi religion, being the alleged residence of the Vewug, the powerful spirit worshiped by the Vewugi faithful. It attracts holymen from all parts of the dominion of the Vewug, who spend many years living in the complex, and taking notes on the actions and omens of the Vewug. To stand in vigil and watch for apparitions and signs of the Vewug is typically the purview of initiated holy man, but with the advent of our liberationist government, there are cries from the people to open the Drupe to pilgrims. Intellectuals and anti-magisterialists cry out for the privilege of visiting the great master of the worldly plane, but the traditionalist clergy are dragging their feet and protesting this as an indignity upon their orders and the house of the Vewug. §RNOTE: If Sesi is occupied, foreign powers may burn the Drupe!§!
Let the Drupe be open to the faithful!
The holy men are right. We must curtail the unitiated.

We are beginning to see notable changes in our economy and consequently our society. The introduction of machines for industrial production has begun to change the way the rest of society organises itself. We are seeing new sets of emerging values among the people of all classes, such as greater consumption levels, emphasis placed on thrift and saving, and new attitudes to goods and marketing. We have also seen the institutionalization of markets: a proliferation of small scale retailers, larger buying and selling firms, and informational periodicals about products. Finally, our government has adapted by showing greater interest in consumer markets. This is, one could believe, the beginning of a dramatic transformation of society.

Society is changing rapidly: in all parts of the world one sees the penetration of mechanised production, mobile capital, and soaring outputs. Every year our country lays down thousands of miles of railway - the tonnage of coal mined is rising exponentially - and every day millions of new bales of cloth are spun. And indeed, for all these things, there is someone to buy it! People clamour for new textiles, coal to warm their hopes, and handsome foreign Nuzhdap carried by steamship. New banking organisations are scrambling to provide capital for new firms which incorporate, under newly permitted limited liability banners, by the day. Society is transforming rapidly, and we are seeing our economy industrialise.

Our society has undergone a staggering transformation. From a largely agrarian society grounded in pre-modern social and governmental norms, now we are truly seeing the beginning of the modern ‘economic’ hominid. The regular order of the day is mechanised production, and people have even begun to get used to the business cycle and the strange swings of production and demand. People understand how to access local markets, they buy goods, and they aspire to the dream of modern mechanized luxury. The government concerns itself greatly with maintaining the norms of the market and organising industrial production, and ‘efficient management’ is the order of the day. The dictates of the manager, the market, and the economic regulator are casual inputs that shape the institutions and values of our society.
Well, tally-ho boys, well done all around.

The $CRISISAREA$ people languish in chains, it is said. They suffer the greatest tyranny under foreign yoke, and everywhere one finds signs of their subjection. Their country has been dismembered by occupation, and surely it should stir all lovers of justice to support their cause! Recently, in fact, it seems occupied $CRISISAREA$ lands have undergone some severe turmoil. Violence and atrocities between locals and governmental elites seems to have ended in a series of well publicized and particularly grisly massacres. The press across the civilized world is crying out for a resolution to this chaos, and a number of powers are attempting to organise a conference to resolve the $CRISISAREA$ question for the time being.
The mighty $COUNTRY_ADJ$ people will have their voice heard on this matter!
More upstart savages clamoring for recognition? Count us out.

The Tehurite or ‘Sedentarian’ tradition is generally believed to have begun as an ideological prop from neolithic regimes in the vales of northern Ishahfazh, designed to discourage migration and to consequently promote stable tax registrars. The ‘virtues of the solid man’ were first proclaimed by the Philosopher-King Oswegose of Miege, and his various writings on the topic became the germ of a large corpus of Sedentarian philosophy, primarily focused on the virtues of stability, changelessness, and abstract notions of cosmic harmony and splendor. The Right to the Familiar is a traditional Tehurite legal tradition that allows those whose way of life has been disrupted by others, politicians or government officials to appeal to the autonomous legal-religious scholarly community for a verdict on the right to maintain traditional ways of life. With the holy man or scholar’s condemnation of the disruptions, there is usually great pressure to right these wrongs.
May earth and sky bless our lands.

It’s been a little while now since we settled the Islands south of Gofakidzia, in the ferocious reaches of the Ishnapt Ocean. Nonetheless, some hardy settlers from our metropole have gone all the way to these stormy islands to settle, and have established a few little fishing communities. A vessel that had been traveling through the Ishnapt has recently pulled into $CAPITAL$ and told us a little bit of the goings on there. They tell us of the ferocious storms that come down from the north, and that the settlers and native Mjhm’an (the ‘Bibs’ as our Gashdzii call them) build their fanzas and cottages on the lee sides of the mountains that tower out of these islands. They tell us of the strange, fatty molluscs that the settlers fish for in the northern waters, and the chewy roots grown there. In sensible Gashdzii fashion, the settlers have taken to calling the Islands ‘Dozmâzhfâ’ and ‘Guzmâzhfâ’, north and south’s land. The Admiralty proposes updating our maps.
The cost of new charts for a silly little bit of pride?
